name: Crimson High
source:
If there's something strange - like a dead girl - in your school.. Who you gonna call? The police, obviously.

As a freshly promoted detective it is upon you to solve the cruel murder of a young girl at the local all-girls high school. For this you have to spend a lot of time with her classmates and other quirky characters. Who knows what kind of evidence you'll find? What secrets you'll uncover? Where those secrets will lead you? Having to spend time with a bunch of teenage girls and their teenage secrets is bound to get interesting for sure.

Monsters, mystery and more await you at Crimson High!

[From [url=https://vertigoavn.itch.io/crimsonhigh]itch.io[/url]]
